type: Source-specific Rao-Blackwellized TWoS extension, added after housing primary results
reason: Diagnose avoidable source-point sampling variance without replacing the frozen original results
scope: Same four geometries, sites, five seeds and original/edited states; walk budgets 16,64,256,1024,4096 frozen before any analytic-variant measurement
algorithm: Replace Green-distributed source-point samples by the analytic ball Green integral of each prescribed compact radial polynomial source. Leave random sphere exits and cross-index products intact.
claim: Conditional-expectation variance reduction under ideal arithmetic and shared exit paths; specialized to analytically integrable sources, not a new general-purpose source oracle
analysis: Use unchanged reference gates, targets and paired bootstrap. Retain the original estimator as ablation. The two lower walk budgets test whether variance reduction permits cheaper queries.
finite_precision: Long-double integral evaluation; clamp tiny negative roundoff to zero; numerical audit, not a formal rounding-bias bound
adaptive_stopping_frozen_before_extensio: Always measure 16/64/256 paths at all counts. At 1024 and 4096, measure only prefixes through the largest still-unresolved query count in each state. A case is closed when a previous budget meets the strictest reference-resolved target (10%, then 20%, then 40%) using the unchanged upper-bootstrap-mean error rule, or when no target has a resolved reference. Retain stop reasons and all measured budgets. This selects the smallest tested path budget attaining the target, not an exhaustive high-budget Pareto front.
